literal_meaning: কূল এবং কিনারা (নদীর তীর বা সীমান্ত)
figurative_meaning_en: synonymous compound word; escape or way out; resolution or relief from difficulty
similar_in_english: light at the end of the tunnel
get out of a tight spot
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমস্যা থেকে কূলকিনারা খুঁজে পাওয়া কঠিন হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There is no way out of this quarrel.
Finding a resolution from the problem has become difficult.
note: Derived from riverine imagery common in Bengali geography, symbolizing finding safety from floods or troubles.
